author: Good Enough
description:
HD 80606 b is one of the most extreme exoplanets ever discovered. Its incredibly elongated orbit sends the planet swinging dangerously close to its star, causing temperatures to rise dramatically in just a matter of hours and creating some of the most violent weather conditions known on any planet.

As HD 80606 b approaches its star, its atmosphere experiences an enormous burst of heat that can trigger powerful storms and winds moving at incredible speeds. This Short explores what makes HD 80606 b so extreme and what a human would experience trying to survive on this terrifying alien world.
title: The Planet With a Metal Ocean 🪐😨 #space #exoplanets #astronomy
